purpose: Representative diagnostic distance to QPS +10% and P99 -20%, not final release acceptance
topology: hosted ubuntu24.04; one process containing loopback TCP client and server; one worker; same two allowed logical CPUs selected on distinct guest-reported (socket,core)
affinity: smallest allowed online CPU, then smallest allowed online CPU on a different guest (socket,core); stop if mapping unavailable
isolationClaim: None; retain guest core/socket/SMT and cgroup observations; no physical-core isolation claim
quantile: nearest rank ceil(n*p), exact integer rational rank, no floating-point percentile rank
pairOrder: odd pair official then dev; even pair dev then official; scenarios rotated by pair index
failurePolicy: retain every planned slot and all raw failures; no replacement, exclusion, retry, adaptive stop or claim from incomplete evidence
releaseBoundary: dev57f06f lacks #931/#933; representative diagnostic does not establish no functional shrink or final 3.0 release acceptance
interopBoundary: No cross-major interoperability gate; each arm uses same-version client/server and its own Generator
aggregation: Per cell median of six paired dev/official QPS ratios and separately six paired P99 ratios. Retain all six ratios and exact rational metrics. No operation pooling, no best round, no cross-cell global pass. All4 cells mandatory; any failed/missing input blocks target observations.
coldPolicy: 8 dedicated cold-only processes must pass before timed launch; each48 timed fresh process repeats all cold controls before3s warmup.
